title: Sleeper Sound: LayerX Uncovers Malicious “Sleeper” Sound Management Extensions with Nearly 1.5 Million Users Worldwide
content: LayerX has unearthed network of malicious “sleeper agent” extensions that appear to serve as infrastructure for future malicious activity, currently installed on nearly 1.5 million users worldwide.   LayerX has discovered a network of browser extensions that appear to serve as ‘sleeper agents’ for future malicious activity.
